data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to flip, rotate, resize, move, delete, edit, and lock widgets.
data.what_it_does: Lindi Sticker Widget allows developers to overlay movable and interactive widgets on top of a base child, such as an image. Users can manipulate stickers with built-in actions like rotating, resizing, flipping, layering, and locking using a custom controller.
use_when: You need to build a photo editor or meme generator app where users can add and manipulate stickers.
You want users to be able to drag, resize, rotate, and layer widgets over an image or background.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based animations or game-engine level manipulations.
You are only displaying static, non-interactive layouts.
strengths: Supports multiple sticker manipulation features out of the box (rotate, resize, move, flip, lock).
Highly customizable controller and sticker action icons.
Allows exporting the final sticker widget layout as a Uint8List image.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of the basic README and example files.
Relies on a specific controller pattern that requires imperative updates for certain actions.
